description: F5: a `struct` type name colliding with the Geometry overlay primitive `grid` raises `ol-reserved-word` at phase-1 registration. Issue #403; since issue #839 the runtime's built-in-name lookup is derived from `@openlogo/parser`'s profile-keyed primitive registry rather than a hand-composed list of arity tables, so `grid` is covered by the registry walk rather than by a named `geometryPrimitiveArity()` branch.

diagnostics.message: grid is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
